payload.claim: The docstring now reads "§4.2.1: auth, mirror fetch, origin refusal, default-branch pin, policy validation, disk headroom, images", folding the new `images` step into the list attributed to §4.2.1. DESIGN.md §4.2.1 names only the first six steps; `images` was added by SA-0289 and is not part of that design section, as `saffron/preflight.py`'s own updated docstrings correctly show by citing `images` to `SA-0289` separately rather than appending it to the §4.2.1 list.
